description: This file defines the Review class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically handling review-related operations such as adding a review, retrieving reviews by product ID, and counting total reviews. The class interacts with the database to manage review data for products, encapsulating methods related to reviews in the catalog module.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Class representing review operations in the catalog, such as adding new reviews and fetching reviews for products.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Inserts a new review record into the database with author, customer ID, product ID, text, rating, and timestamps.

methods.name: getReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Fetches a list of reviews for a given product ID with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Returns the total number of reviews associated with a specific product ID.
